scope: Keys work right with Num Lock on, and fewer virus warnings by mistake.

topics.title: Fewer false virus warnings
details: Voice Companion is now built with its own copy of a part that virus scanners often flag by mistake.
This should mean fewer warnings when you download or install Voice Companion.
Some warnings can still appear until Voice Companion is signed.

topics.title: Num Lock
details: With Num Lock on, keys now work as they should.
Before, Num Lock could make a plain key act like Alt plus that key.
